about.title: What is Breathedge 2
paragraphs: Breathedge 2 is a space survival adventure by RedRuins Softworks and HypeTrain Digital, the direct sequel to Breathedge. The developers call it "Subnautica in space — with a chicken and a bunch of stupid jokes."
The Man, his spacesuit AI, and the immortal Chicken fight the Breathedge Corporation with scrap, duct tape, and questionable machines. Early Access launched Aug 31, 2026 with the first story chapter.
